claims.statement: TypeScript strict mode is mandatory with no `any` types; shared types live in shared/src/types/ and Zod schemas in shared/src/schemas/ mirror them with z.infer used over hand-rolled interfaces.

All database access goes through Drizzle ORM with a single schema file at backend/src/db/schema.ts (pgEnums declared at top); migrations use pnpm db:generate / pnpm db:migrate, and production applies via make prod-migrate which excludes *.revert.sql (commit 45fbad3).

Financial conventions: the ledger is append-only with ADJUSTMENT used for corrections and UNLOCK_REVERSAL for trip unlocks; all monetary math goes through round2dp() and computeTripTotals() from shared/src/calculations/; revenue is recorded ex-VAT (net) and costs incl-VAT (gross); VND displays with no decimal places while internal math preserves 2dp via round2dp.

Fuel pricing: fuelPriceApplied is the config snapshot at trip creation (immutable), fuelActualUnitPrice is the per-trip override, and the effective price is `actual ?? snapshot`; one driver per trip is the invariant even though a truck can have many drivers over time.
RBAC follows a dual-layer pattern combining casbinAuthz('resource') with requireRoles(...) — resources without a Casbin policy row deny everyone except the ADMIN wildcard p, ADMIN, *, *.

Audit middleware emits one Vietnamese-language audit row per mutating API call (templates in backend/src/services/audit-templates.ts), regardless of how many tables the handler touches; user-facing copy is in Vietnamese and query endpoint is /api/audit-logs (ADMIN/MANAGER only).

Frontend conventions: Tailwind CSS v4 via @tailwindcss/vite (no tailwind.config); page-scoped CSS in frontend/src/styles/; no !important and no truncation of column values; the <Money> component renders VND with dong sign as subtitle-sized unit; statusStrip (3x20px color bar) appears on every status display; no raw DB IDs in UI text — only business labels.

DRIVER and FORWARDER pages are mobile-first responsive with Tailwind responsive utilities; server state uses TanStack Query; there is no global state library — only React context (auth) and custom hooks like useAuth, useCatalogs, useAuditLogs, useClickOutside, useTripForm.
